decisions.reason: The carpet sits close to the core offer, still has its own page in 2024, and adds little cost to a broad collection, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations it stays.
The premium hand-knotted wool silk carpet fits the firm's craftsmanship identity and remains prominently presented, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The corner bench moved from its own page to a mention in 2024, which signals weaker emphasis, but it is still promoted as new and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results are uncertain.
This low-pile carpet keeps its own page, and the sibling Product C was already pruned, so the remaining designs likely meet aspirations and stay.
The swivel shell chair line has several models, is consistently presented, and serves both residential and contract channels, so it likely meets performance aspirations.
